text:
Stop waiting for "perfect code" to start seeking funding for your open-source projects. 

The most effective beginner habit is documenting your progress weekly. Don't just ship features; share the technical hurdles you’ve cleared and what’s coming next. This transparency turns a codebase into a journey that people want to join. 

When you show the effort behind the scenes, you build more than just users—you build trust. And in open source, trust is the ultimate foundation for sustainable funding.
